title: Go Theme Review
description: A documentation-led profile of Go’s Gutenberg-first workflow and its focus on helping makers build with WordPress blocks.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped, documentation-led Go WordPress theme profile from KreativWP.
highlights: The official listing describes Go as a Gutenberg-first WordPress theme
Its listed features include editor styles, custom colours, wide blocks, and ecommerce support
The theme is positioned as a maker-focused route to building with WordPress
bestFor: People who want a straightforward Gutenberg-oriented theme and will verify that its design controls suit their ongoing publishing workflow.
researchScope: This profile checks Go’s current WordPress.org listing. It describes the documented block-editor focus and feature set, not an independent assessment of performance or support.
caveats: No controlled install, design-system study, ecommerce build, or accessibility audit has been completed. Test a representative page and editing flow before using it as a project default.
